text:
Situation: Potassium phosphate 224 mg/mL 15 mL vials are in use at both campuses. Corvale East holds 227 vials at 10.3 vials per day, giving 22.1 days on hand. Corvale General holds 412 vials at 12.9 vials per day, giving 31.9 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include potassium phosphate as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers three to four weeks at present usage. No FDA shortage listing exists. Multiple manufacturers are available and not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places orders with B. Braun Medical Inc. as primary source; buyer approves.
2. Buyer adds CIVICA, INC. as secondary source; buyer approves.
3. Buyer adds Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as tertiary source; buyer approves.
4. Buyer adds Somerset Therapeutics, LLC as quaternary source; buyer approves.
5. Buyer monitors daily usage and inventory at both campuses; buyer approves.
6. Buyer reports supply status to P&T committee at next scheduled meeting; P&T committee chair approves.

Not recommended: No allocation limits, no therapeutic substitutions, and no emergency purchases at this time.
